lines.japanese: 「えっと、本当にいいんだよね？」
lines.english: “Um... you're really sure about this?”

lines.japanese: 「うん大丈夫……私には羽田君しかいないから」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I'll be all right... You're the only person I have, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあいくよ。いっせーので……」
lines.english: “All right, then. Ready, and...”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、いっせーの……」
lines.english: “O-okay. Ready, and...”

lines.japanese: 「せっ」
lines.english: “Go!”

lines.japanese: 「おれ、飲みもの買ってくるよ」
lines.english: “I'll go buy us something to drink.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは前に付きあっていたひとが忘れられず、合い鍵をずっと持っていたらしい。
lines.english: Apparently Yamashina had never been able to forget the person she used to date, and had held on to the spare key all this time.

lines.japanese: 今日は、それを返しに行くから付きあってほしいと言われて、相手の住むマンションまでやってきた。
lines.english: Today, she asked me to come with her while she gave it back, so we came to the apartment building where the other person lived.

lines.japanese: 彼女は合い鍵を返す踏ん切りがついたのは、僕のお陰だと言ってくれた。
lines.english: She told me I'd helped her finally make up her mind to give the spare key back.

lines.japanese: 彼女はありがとうと言ってくれたけど、僕は恋人なんだから付きあうのは当然だ。それが平日の日中だったとしても一緒に行くと思う。
lines.english: She had thanked me, but of course I would come with her. I was her boyfriend. I would have gone even in the middle of a weekday.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: コーンポタージュの缶を拾う僕の後ろを誰かが通りすぎて行った。あれは……前にモンキホーテで見た……。
lines.english: As I bent to retrieve a can of creamy corn soup, someone walked past behind me. That was... the man I had seen at Monki Hote...

lines.japanese: 「あれえ？　瑠樺ちゃんじゃない」
lines.english: “Well, well. If it isn’t little Ruka.”
“...What? Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱりそーだあ。なにまたこんなトコで。いい加減諦めなよ」
lines.english: “I knew it was you. What are you doing back here again? Give it up already.”

lines.japanese: 「……今日は、鍵を返しにきた」
lines.english: “...I came to return the key today.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、やっと家宅不法侵入やめてくれんの？　はは、その方がいいよ、お互いの安定の為にもさ」
lines.english: Oh, you're finally gonna stop breaking into the place? Ha ha, probably for the best. Better for both of us to keep things stable, y'know?

lines.japanese: 「聞かないだろうけど、若いうち健全な恋愛しときなよ。君のはソレ恋じゃなくて依存っていうんだ」
lines.english: “You won't listen, but try having a healthy relationship while you're still young. What you've got there isn't love. It's dependency.”

lines.japanese: 「眠れない夜を過ごした者にしか理解らない夜を、忘れて久しいその口が愛を紡ぐな」
lines.english: “Do not weave words of love with lips that have long forgotten the nights known only to those who have lain awake through them.”

lines.japanese: 「瑠樺ちゃん顔はかわいいんだから勿体ないよ。いやコレほんとに親切で言ってんの。今まで多少厳しいこと言ってたのも瑠樺ちゃんのための優しさよ？」
lines.english: “You have such a pretty face, Ruka. It's a waste. No, I mean this as sincere advice. Even the harsh things I've said to you were kindness for your own good, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい……うるさい……うるさいなあもう！」
lines.english: “Shut up... Shut up... Oh, just shut up!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、待ってって。あーあー、この子ホントかわいそうだなあ。どうしてこういう一本ブッ飛んでる子って、顔はかわいいことが多いのかなあ」
lines.english: “Wait, come on. God, I really do feel sorry for her. Why do the girls with a screw loose so often have such pretty faces?”

lines.japanese: 「あのねえ瑠樺ちゃん、恋愛したいならまず自分にも責任持ちなさいよ。そのために自信も持ちなさいって。でないと同じこと何回でも繰りかえすよ？」
lines.english: Listen, Ruka. If you want a relationship, start by taking responsibility for yourself, okay? And that means having some confidence in yourself too. Otherwise you're just gonna do the same thing over and over.

lines.japanese: 「分からない、君の立つ場所には柵があるだけで僕がいる高度と変わらないのに、どうしてそんなにも不遜でいられるの？」
lines.english: “I don't understand. The only difference between the place where you stand and the height where I dwell is that yours has a railing. How can you remain so arrogant?”

lines.japanese: 「あーもう、瑠樺ちゃん、相変わらずひとをイラつかせるのだけは上手いなあ。じゃあ分かってて釣られてあげるけどさ、ひとン家勝手に上がって寝っころがってたら、ソレ犯罪だからね？」
lines.english: “Oh, honestly, Ruka. You never lost your gift for getting under people's skin. Fine, I know you're baiting me, but I'll bite: letting yourself into somebody else's home and lying around in it is a crime.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「いやまさかバレてないとは思ってないでしょ。だって明らかに侵入した形跡あるし、カメラ仕掛けておいたもん。こっちにも責任あるから警察沙汰にはしなかったけどさあ」
lines.english: Come on, you didn't actually think we hadn't noticed, did you? You left obvious signs you'd been in there, and we put up a camera. We had some blame in this too, so we didn't call the cops, but still...

lines.japanese: 「はいはい泣かないの。ね？　んふふ、じゃあもう来ないでね。はいサヨナラ～」
lines.english: “There, there. Don't cry. All right? Heh heh. Just don't come back again. Bye-bye.”

lines.japanese: 「それは一度でも愛したひとに向ける言葉じゃないよ」
lines.english: “That isn't how you speak to someone you once loved.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なに？　誰？　部外者は……」
lines.english: “What? Who are you? This is none of your—”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、成田クン？　やあ、久しぶり」
lines.english: “Wait, Narita? Hey. Long time no see.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: いつか見た男のひとは、まるで僕と話したことのあるような口ぶりだった。人違いでもしてるんだろうか。
lines.english: The man I had seen before spoke as though we had talked before. Was he mistaking me for someone else?

lines.japanese: 「この前はガード下でお会い出来なくて残念、僕あん時デートでさあ。成田クン、カッコ良かったんだって？　俺たちのハリューと互角に戦ったって話でしょ、もう掲示板で大人気だよ、んふふ」
lines.english: “Shame we missed you under the tracks the other day. I was on a date then. I hear you put on quite a show, Narita—you fought our Hariu to a draw, right? You're a star on the message boards now. Heh heh.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、僕らも今はフレイムバーズ傘下のチームだからさ。まさかケンカとかしないよね、今後は仲良くしてよ」
lines.english: “Oh, our team answers to the Flame Birds now too. You're not planning to pick a fight, are you? Let's all get along from here on out.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いえ、ケンカをするつもりはありませんよ。でも山科さんに言ったことは謝ってください」
lines.english: “No, I have no intention of fighting. But apologize for what you said to Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君……」
lines.english: “Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「山科さんって……はっ？　なに、成田クンまさか瑠樺ちゃんと知り合い？」
lines.english: “Yamashina...? What? Narita, don't tell me you know Ruka.”

lines.japanese: 「ナリタじゃないもん！　羽田君だもん！」
lines.english: “He's not Narita! He's Haneda!”

lines.japanese: 「なにハネダって。ハンドルネーム？　それよりもしか、瑠樺ちゃんの新しい依存の相手って成田クンなの？」
lines.english: “What's a Haneda? Your handle? More to the point, is Narita the new person you're dependent on, Ruka?”

lines.japanese: 「依存じゃありません、おれは山科さんの恋人です」
lines.english: “This isn't dependency. I'm Yamashina's boyfriend.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君……ありがとう」
lines.english: “Haneda... thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「うわっ！　あちゃー、そうだったんだあ……参ったなあ、俺たちのハリューと互角に戦った成田クンが瑠樺ちゃんの？」
lines.english: “Whoa! Well, damn. I see... So Narita, the guy who fought our Hariu to a draw, is Ruka's boyfriend?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ。待って待って、いま色々言ったけどさ、こっちだって被害者だったんだよ。あ、ビデオも内容確認しただけで、すぐに燃やしたから残ってないからね。ホントだよ」
lines.english: “Wait, wait. I know I said a few things, but we were the victims here too. And we only watched enough of the video to see what was on it, then burned it right away. There isn't a copy left. I swear.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことじゃなくて、一度でも付きあったひとに対して、さっきの言い方は酷いんじゃないかと思うんです」
lines.english: “That isn't the point. I'm saying that the way you spoke to someone you once dated was cruel.”

lines.japanese: 「いやさあ、一方的に悪者扱いしないで、こっちの言い分も聞いてよ」
lines.english: “Come on. Don't decide I'm the villain without even hearing my side.”

lines.japanese: 「謝ってください」
lines.english: “Apologize.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、聞く耳持たずか……はい、ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Wow. Not listening at all, are you? Fine. I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは今どんな気持ちなんだろう。彼女は頭を下げる男のひとをじっと見つめていた。
lines.english: What was Yamashina feeling now? She stared without a word at the man bowing his head.

lines.japanese: 「あのさあ、成田……じゃないやハネダクン。ぶっちゃけ今どんぐらい瑠樺ちゃんにハマってんの？」
lines.english: “Listen, Narita—sorry, Haneda. Honestly, how deep are you in with Ruka right now?”

lines.japanese: 「これから先ずっと一緒にいるつもりです」
lines.english: “I intend to stay with her for the rest of my life.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ……そんなこと、簡単に言わない方がいいと思うけどなあ……」
lines.english: “Oh... I don't think that's the kind of thing you should say so lightly...”

lines.japanese: 「おれと山科さんは大丈夫です。適当に言ってるつもりはありませんから」
lines.english: “Yamashina and I will be all right. I am not saying it lightly.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう……ううっ、うっ、私も本当に、今は羽田君のことだけが好きだよ。これからもずっと好きでいられる自信があるもん……ぐすっ」
lines.english: “Thank you... Oh... I truly do love only you now, Haneda. I know I can go on loving you forever... Sniff.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだあ……はは、祝福するよハネダクンに」
lines.english: “I see… Ha. Well, you have my blessing, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなのいりません。確かにあなたと山科さんは途中で想いがすれ違ってしまったかもしれないけど、おれは山科さんときちんと話しあって、向かいあって生きていくつもりなんです」
lines.english: “I don't need your blessing. Maybe somewhere along the way, what you and Yamashina felt stopped reaching each other. But I intend to talk things through with her and live my life facing her honestly.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあんたね、そんな大げさな話になることがそもそもマズイって」
lines.english: Look, the fact that it turns into this huge thing at all is the problem.

lines.japanese: 「そうやってひとを見下したら、恋愛なんて出来ないじゃないですか。おれは山科さんと同じ目線に立って、どちらかに寄りかかるんじゃなくてお互いに支えあっていきたいんです」
lines.english: “If you look down on another person that way, how can you ever love them? I want Yamashina and me to be equals, supporting each other rather than having one of us depend entirely on the other.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたが依存って呼んでいることも、きちんと向きあっていけば恋愛になるんです。きっかけがどうであれ、いつか真実になるのならおれはその気持ちを信じたいんです」
lines.english: “Even what you call dependency can become love if two people face it honestly. However a feeling begins, if it can one day become true, then I want to believe in it.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう……羽田君、本当にありがとう……私、羽田君だけは裏切らないって信じてる……絶対に離れないよ」
lines.english: “Thank you... Thank you so much, Haneda... I believe you're the one person who will never betray me... I'll never leave you.”

lines.japanese: 「あのさハネダクン、もう手遅れかもしれないけど、瑠樺ちゃんは遊びにはいいかもしれないけど、マジ恋愛すると最後ヤバイからね」
lines.english: “Listen, Haneda. Maybe it's already too late, but Ruka might be fine for some casual fun. Fall for her seriously and it'll get ugly in the end.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか遊びでも手を出さない方がいいとだけ言っておくよ。なにしろ手ェ出さなくても、一晩泊めただけでカン違いして、ずーっと入りびたっちゃうようなボダ子ちゃんだから。あっこれ、実話なんで念のため」
lines.english: I mean, I'd tell you not to touch her even as a joke. You don't even have to lay a hand on her—let her stay one night and she'll get the wrong idea and keep showing up forever. That's the kind of borderline chick she is. Oh, and just so you know, that really happened.

lines.japanese: 「他人の痛みが分からないことは悲しいことだと思うんです」
lines.english: I think it's sad when you can't understand someone else's pain.

lines.japanese: 「あなたには出来なかったかもしれないけど、おれは山科さんを幸せにしてみせます！」
lines.english: “Maybe you couldn't do it, but I will make Yamashina happy!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、はいはい、ムキになんないでよ、僕だって親切で言ってんだから」
lines.english: “All right, all right. Don't get worked up. I'm only trying to help you.”

lines.japanese: 「山科さん、いこう」
lines.english: “Come on, Yamashina. Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……羽田君のおかげで私もはっきりと言えるよ。私、必ず幸せになるから。それであなたたちのこと見返すから。絶対に後悔させてみせる」
lines.english: “Mm-hm... Thanks to Haneda, I can say it clearly too. I will be happy. Then I'll prove every one of you wrong. I swear I'll make you regret looking down on me.”

lines.japanese: 「それじゃバイバイ」
lines.english: “Bye-bye.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、後悔させるとか言ってる時点で、おかしいと思うんだけどなあ……」
lines.english: “I mean, wanting to make us regret it is kind of weird in the first place…”

lines.japanese: 僕は山科さんの手をとり、歩きだした。
lines.english: I took Yamashina’s hand and started walking.

lines.japanese: もしかしたら僕よりも彼の方が大人なのかもしれない。僕の言っていることは間違っているのかもしれない。
lines.english: Perhaps he was more of an adult than I was. Perhaps what I had said was wrong.

lines.japanese: だけど山科さんに対する気持ちだけは本物だから大丈夫。いま手の中にある彼女の手を強く握りしめながらそう思った。
lines.english: But my feelings for Yamashina were real, so I knew it was okay. I thought that as I squeezed the hand I was holding.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね山科さん、勝手なこと言っちゃって」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, Yamashina. I went and said all those things without asking you.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、ありがとう。こんなに愛してもらって、私いま世界で一番幸せな女の子だと思う」
lines.english: “No. Thank you. To be loved this much... I think I must be the happiest girl in the world.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど前付きあってたの、今のひとじゃないよ」
lines.english: “But the person I used to date wasn't that man.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 驚いた。僕は思わず山科さんを振りかえった。
lines.english: Startled, I spun around to look at Yamashina.

lines.japanese: 「え、だってこの前モンキであのひとだって……」
lines.english: “But at Monki the other day, you said it was him...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは一瞬考えこむ仕草をとると、心外そうな顔で思いきり首を横に振った。
lines.english: Yamashina paused in thought for a moment, then shook her head vigorously, looking almost offended.

lines.japanese: 「違うよ、あのひとじゃなくて、一緒にいたひと」
lines.english: “No. Not him. The person who was with him.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 思いかえしてみる。もしかして後の席か隣に誰かいたのかな……。
lines.english: I searched my memory. Had someone been sitting behind him, perhaps? Or beside him...?

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめん、でもあのひとじゃなかったら、どうして全部知ってたのかな……」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry, but if it wasn't that man, how did he know everything...?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、だって一緒にいたでしょ？」
lines.english: “What? They were together, weren’t they?”

lines.japanese: 「一緒に？　一緒にいたのってあのひとの今の恋人くらいだよね……」
lines.english: “Together? The only person with him was his current girlfriend...”

lines.japanese: 「うんそのひと」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Her.”

lines.japanese: 「そのひと……って……」
lines.english: “Her... you mean...”

lines.japanese: どういうことだろう。僕は間抜けた表情のまま山科さんの解説を待った。
lines.english: What did she mean? I waited, slack-jawed, for Yamashina to explain.

lines.japanese: 「最初は家庭教師だったんだけど、ロックバードのことを教えてもらって、一緒にライブも行くようになって……それから家庭教師の期間が終わっても、会うようになって、そのまま付きあうようになったんだ」
lines.english: “She was my private tutor at first. Then she introduced me to Rockbird, and we started going to shows together... We kept seeing each other after she stopped tutoring me, and eventually we began dating.”

lines.japanese: 「え、だって女のひと……ええっ」
lines.english: “But she was a woman... What?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。もしかしたらあの男のひとが言うとおり、彼女に対しては依存してただけなのかもしれないね。羽田君に対する気持ちと比べてみればよく分かるよ。だってぜんぜん愛情の深さが違うもん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Maybe that man was right, and I was just dependent on her. I can tell when I compare it to how I feel about you. I mean, what I feel for you is so much deeper.”

lines.japanese: ああ、そうか……だから山科さんは、前のひとと肉体関係もなかったし、学校の誰も付きあっている相手を知らなかったんだ。
lines.english: Oh, right... That was why Yamashina had never slept with her ex, and why nobody at school knew who she was dating.

lines.japanese: 「そっか、そうだったんだ……」
lines.english: “I see. So that was it...”

lines.japanese: 「えと、引いちゃった？」
lines.english: “Um... does that put you off?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、そんなことないよ。ただ山科さんのことがもっと好きになっただけなんだ」
lines.english: “No, not at all. It only made me like you even more.”

lines.japanese: 「その、やっぱり山科さんと初めて付きあう男性が俺だってことがなんだか嬉しいし……」
lines.english: “Well, I suppose I’m happy to know I’m the first man you’ve dated...”

lines.japanese: 「これからもよろしく」
lines.english: “Let's take care of each other from now on.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: ちょっとびっくりしたけど、山科さんの調子も戻ったみたいでよかった。これでもう過去に縛られることもないと思う。
lines.english: It had surprised me a little, but I was glad Yamashina seemed to be herself again. I thought the past would no longer have a hold on her.

lines.japanese: これからは僕が山科さんを守ってあげよう。ずっと山科さんと一緒にいよう。今までの分も、これからも、いっぱい、いっぱい愛してあげよう。
lines.english: From now on, I would protect Yamashina. I would stay with her forever. I would love her enough to make up for the past, and keep on loving her. So much, so much.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん、これからずっと一緒にいよう。俺の言葉で喜んでくれるなら、何度だって言うから」
lines.english: “Let's stay together forever, Yamashina. If hearing me say it makes you happy, I'll say it as many times as you need.”

lines.japanese: 「俺は絶対に裏切らないよ」
lines.english: “I will never betray you.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、泣きそうなくらい嬉しい」
lines.english: “Thank you. I'm so happy I could cry.”

lines.japanese: そう言った彼女の瞳はすでに涙を湛えていた。
lines.english: Her eyes were already brimming with tears as she spoke.

lines.japanese: だけど、今までで一番綺麗な笑顔を浮かべてくれた。
lines.english: And yet she gave me the most beautiful smile I had ever seen from her.

lines.japanese: 歩いていこう、彼女と二人で。
lines.english: We would walk on, the two of us together.

lines.japanese: どこまでもずっと。
lines.english: On and on, wherever the road might lead.
